senses.sense_definition: Any of the large, hairy spiders belonging to the family Theraphosidae, often kept as pets.

examples.text: Many people keep a <w>tarantula</w> as a pet because they are fascinating to watch.

target_lang_translations.zh: 许多人把<w>捕鸟蛛</w>当作宠物养，因为观察它们非常有趣。

examples.text: The <w>tarantula</w> is a large, hairy spider that lives in many parts of the world.

target_lang_translations.zh: <w>捕鸟蛛</w>是一种生活在世界许多地方的大型多毛蜘蛛。

target_lang_definitions.zh: 属于捕鸟蛛科的大型多毛蜘蛛，常被当作宠物饲养。

zh.target_lang_sense_clarification: 指生物学分类上的捕鸟蛛科蜘蛛。
指代该类大型蜘蛛的通用名称。

senses.sense_definition: A large spider, often belonging to the infraorder Mygalomorphae, sometimes mistakenly called by this name.

examples.text: Some people call large huntsman spiders a <w>tarantula</w> due to their size.

target_lang_translations.zh: 有些人因为体型大，把大型高脚蛛也称为<w>捕鸟蛛</w>。

examples.text: The stadium roof looks like a giant metal <w>tarantula</w> sitting over the city.

target_lang_translations.zh: 体育场的屋顶看起来就像一只巨大的金属<w>捕鸟蛛</w>蹲伏在城市上方。

target_lang_definitions.zh: 一种大型蜘蛛，常指捕鸟蛛下目，有时被误称为塔兰托毒蛛。

senses.sense_definition: A type of wolf spider from southern Europe, historically associated with a dancing mania called tarantism.

examples.text: In the past, people believed the bite of a <w>tarantula</w> caused a strange urge to dance.

target_lang_translations.zh: 过去，人们认为被<w>狼蛛</w>咬伤会导致一种奇怪的跳舞冲动。

examples.text: The original <w>tarantula</w> is a wolf spider found in the Mediterranean region.

target_lang_translations.zh: 最初的<w>狼蛛</w>是指在地中海地区发现的一种蜘蛛。

traits.comment: Refers to historical folklore regarding the spider.

target_lang_definitions.zh: 一种产于南欧的狼蛛，历史上与被称为“塔兰托舞病”的舞蹈狂热有关。

zh.target_lang_sense_clarification: 指历史上最初被称为塔兰托毒蛛的欧洲狼蛛。
